kind: truth reconciliation, not a feature task
summary: The five failing ontology gates are repaired and the full file is green at 93/93 in a single complete run (1,234.76s, zero failures). None of the five was deleted and none was weakened: two were stale pinned constants, three were assertions whose premise the D-0023/D-0024 enrichment had falsified and which are now re-expressed to pin what is actually true. Seven false or overbroad customer-facing claims are corrected across BRIEF.md, NEO4J_FIDELITY_AUDIT.md, NEO4J_RAI_MAPPING.md and NEO4J_PARITY_MATRIX.md, each with its superseded wording quoted in place and dated so the audit trail survives. CLAIMS_AUDIT.md carries a resolution ledger and rewritten safe-to-say / must-not-be-said lists. Two further false claims and two stale code comments were found that the claims audit had missed.
